title: O4: flame goes out as the flow is turned down
what_to_watch: A 3/8-inch clear PMMA rod burning at its upstream tip. The crew lowered the fan step by step; the flame shrinks and goes out about 21 s into this clip. On-screen AIR is the duct flow display in cm/s; it responds in about 1 min (report p.66).

title: O7: blowoff when the fan is stepped to maximum
what_to_watch: The on-screen FAN readout jumps to 122 (fan voltage x10, its maximum). The flame is pushed back and blows off about 15 s into this clip, while the AIR readout is still climbing. That lag is why Panel 2 treats blowoff flows as upper bounds.

title: O1: Nikon still sequence of a burning rod
what_to_watch: Still images from the Nikon camera (Total Frames Shot in the PSI table), shown as a slideshow, not real time. Camera settings are printed on each frame.
